title: Horizontal Wind Model
text: Transform horizontal wind into body-axes coordinates, 3 inputs, 1 output, {Units} sets Input and output units Metric; {Wind speed source}, {Wind speed at altitude (m/s)}, {Wind direction source} and {Wind direction at altitude (degrees clockwise from north)}. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Units
params.values: Input and output units Metric (MKS) (default) | English (Velocity in ft/s) | English (Velocity in kts)

params.name: Wind direction at altitude (degrees clockwise from north)
